opening.argument: The video presents a purported free Walmart gift-card generator that promises codes “easy and super fast,” directs viewers to an external website, and ties obtaining the cards to following steps on that site. The displayed offer requires a viewer to submit information, including a valid email and ZIP code, while a later form requests first and last names, email, phone, and birth-date details. The sequence provides no evidence of gift-card delivery; instead, later material presents unrelated personal-prophecy quiz content. Taken together, the low-barrier reward promise, external claim flow, and collection of personal information establish the deceptive acquisition pattern shown here without requiring a claim of confirmed financial loss.
